chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad, from one of our companions, from Ibn Mahboub, raising it (to the Imam), said:

He (peace be upon him) said: 'You should say in the last Rak'ah of the Salat of Ja'far (peace be upon him): O One Who is Clothed in Honour and Dignity! O One Who Girds Himself with Glory and is Generous with it! O One to whom Glorification is befitting alone! O One whose Knowledge encompasses all things! O Possessor of Bounty and Grace! O Possessor of Favours and Grace! O Possessor of Power and Generosity! I ask You by the knots of Honour on Your Throne, and by the peak of Mercy in Your Book, and by Your Greatest, Most Exalted Name, and Your Perfect Words, that You send blessings upon Muhammad and the Progeny of Muhammad, and that You do for me such and such.'

key_terms.الاسْمُ الْأَعْظَمُ: Al-Ism al-A'zam (The Greatest Name of God)
key_terms.صَلَاةُ جَعْفَرٍ: Salat al-Ja'far (Prayer of Ja'far), a specific devotional prayer

ai.seo_question: What is the text of the supplication recited in the last Rak'ah of Salat al-Ja'far?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi outlines the specific supplication for the final Rak'ah of Salat al-Ja'far, highlighting the Shia practice of invoking divine attributes such as 'Izz (Honor) and 'Waqar (Dignity) as means of acceptance. It reflects the theological emphasis on Tawassul (seeking intercession) through Allah's greatest names and the eternal bond with the Ahl al-Bayt, reinforcing the prayer's role in personal devotion and spiritual connection.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, from one of our companions, from Ibn Mahboub, raising it, said,

‘Heasws said: ‘You should be saying in the last Rak’at from the Salāt of Ja’faras, ‘O One Who is Clothed in Honour and Dignity! O One Who Grants with the Glory and is Prestiged with it! O One Who, the Glorification is not befitting except for Himazwj! O One Who Reckons everything in Hisazwj Knowledge! O One with the Bounties and the Abundance! O One with the Favours and the Grace! O One with the Power and the Benevolence! I ask Youazwj by the Honourable Splendour from Yourazwj Throne, and by the peak of the Mercy from Yourazwj Book, and by Yourazwj Magnificent Name, the Exalted, and Yourazwj complete Speech, that Youazwj Send Blessings upon Muhammad and the Progenyasws of Muhammadsaww, and that Youazwj should do such and such with me’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from certain individuals of our people from ibn Mahbub in a marfu‘ manner that the Imam said: “In the last Rak‘at (sajdah of last Rak‘at), in Salah (prayer) of Ja’far, you should say this.

‘O the One, Who has dressed up in majesty and dignity, who is kind with glory and is gracious with glory, You are the One, besides whom no one deserves Tasbih (glorification). (You are) the One whose knowledge has encompassed all things, the bountiful and generous, the One who does favors with additional generosity and the powerful and gracious. I appeal to You through the majestic qualities of Your Throne and the limits of mercy from Your book and through Your great, the most High name and perfect words. Allahumma Salli ‘Ala Muhammad wa ‘Ali Muhammad (O Allah grant Muhammad and his family a compensation worthy of their serving Your cause). Please make my such and such wishes come true.’”
